rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE for the biennium in which the license is first issued.
rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses sponsored or recognized by local, state, regional, national or international dental or medical professional organizations; college-level courses at CODA- or otherwise accredited institutions; study groups per DE 13.02(4)
rules.notes: Reporting period Oct 1 (odd year) - Sep 30 (next odd year). At least 25 h clinical dentistry/medicine. CPR and AED must be current (attested at renewal). 12+ months in an accredited residency meets the CE. DE 13 text not read (docs.legis.wisconsin.gov timed out).

topics.who: Current CPR and AED, attested at renewal
